tex_content.html:
For every compact Riemannian manifold $(X,g)$ and every $\eta >0$, there is $0<\zeta <\eta /2$ such that every $C^1$ loop of length less than $\eta $ bounds a disk of area less than $\eta $.
Proof

\sketch Use radial geodesics inside a normal ball; the cone area tends uniformly to zero with the loop length.

□

Proposition
[Forward difference quotient for $W_\xi $]
